decision_question: Can the thickener feedstock be recorded as a design-space material?
hypothesis: A thickener feedstock whose identity and lot are recorded can enter the design space without any property being invented.
uncertainty: Synthetic test fixture / NOT_FOR_PHYSICAL_EXECUTION: the supplier has not supplied every property, so one is recorded as a GAP.

evidence.statement: Synthetic test fixture / NOT_FOR_PHYSICAL_EXECUTION: the supplier datasheet records the fatty acid trade name and lot.

decision_rule: Register a material only with identity (supplier / trade name / lot), a chemistry family, at least one recorded property, and a dated price.
result: The thickener feedstock is recorded as a design-space material.
